Package hadur117.sepia

Class AimBelief

java.lang.Object
hadur117.sepia.AimBelief
public final class AimBelief extends Object
Where the enemy aims: a belief over guess factors, the chance that a wave's bullet lies on a given stretch of bearings (JET-2's "aim belief").

A guess factor is the bullet's bearing off the line to where Sepia stood when the shot was fired, over the widest escape a body at full speed could make (asin(8 / speed)), positive the way Sepia was travelling. The belief starts from two simple aims, head-on (guess factor 0) and linear (the factor Sepia's lateral speed gives), over a thin even floor, and learns every bullet whose heading Sepia sees: one that hits it, and one its own bullet meets. Bins are smoothed over a few neighbours, as a guess-factor gun's are.

The belief is kept for the battle, so what one round reveals guides the next. It is not a verdict on the gun: Recognition (EXACT, SIMPLE, LEARNER) is a later stage of the design.
